final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS option_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg COLLATE BINARY = s.transref COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY = r.trdref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS option_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), differences AS (SELECT g.transref, g.tradekind, g.option_avg, g.option_avg - o.option_avg AS difference FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.option_avg IS NOT NULL), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(difference) AS mean_difference FROM differences GROUP BY tradekind), selected AS (SELECT d.tradekind, d.option_avg, d.difference, d.difference - a.mean_difference AS excess FROM differences AS d JOIN type_averages AS a ON d.tradekind COLLATE BINARY = a.tradekind COLLATE BINARY WHERE d.difference > a.mean_difference) SELECT tradekind, AVG(option_avg), AVG(difference), AVG(excess) FROM selected GROUP BY tradekind
